Folks — heads up from the APAC side. Sydney and Auckland teams just flagged that their clocks moved forward overnight for local DST and some calendar entries auto-shifted. Two operational impacts:

- The Option A and B times we proposed will appear an hour earlier locally for APAC attendees if invites are created in UTC or CET without explicit local-time pins.
- Several APAC attendees prefer a 19:00–21:00 local window; any candidate at 20:00 AEDT is still fine, but we should avoid slots that straddle midnight after the change.

Recommendation: create calendar invites with explicit local times (e.g., 20:00 AEDT / 09:00 CET) and include the TZ identifier in the event title. Also set the invite to show both original organizer TZ and attendee TZ in the description. I'll coordinate with ops to confirm exact offsets and send a short note to attendees.

-Markus
Regional Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
